findings.body: If a second Google sign-in reads `member` before onboarding commits, its pending-sign-in upsert can wait until onboarding deletes that pending row, then create a new one. The second sign-in receives a pending session even though the member now exists. A later onboarding attempt for that session can hit the unique Google account constraint. Recheck for an existing member after this race before issuing a pending session.
findings.title: A concurrent sign-in can leave an existing member with a pending session

findings.body: Onboarding rejects every submission until a published notice exists. This branch creates the notice table but publishes no version; the integration test supplies one as a fixture. T3 must publish the approved text before a real pending sign-in can become a member.
findings.title: Later: T3 must publish a privacy notice before onboarding can complete

findings.body: The branch adds `.factory/stories/CWF-1/tasks/T2.json` outside the permitted paths. This review and task-status record is not needed to deliver the sign-in API, contract, auth-flow document, or account-setup checklist.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated task-state file
